description.value: Pizza Garden is a BC-based Neapolitan pizza chain with over 25 years in the industry, serving wood-fired pizzas with authentic charred crusts, san marzano-style tomatoes, and creamy mozzarella. The Abbotsford location at Trethewey Street is one of more than a dozen locations across British Columbia. Cyclists can order ahead via the Pizza Garden app and choose pickup or delivery.

address.value: 2653 Trethewey Street, Unit 108, Abbotsford, BC V2T 0B5
